welcome-message: You feel like something bad will happen today
imm-welcome: Welcome message when entering the world
imm-desc: All chances in percent (1 = 1 %). Changes apply immediately.
imm-desc-chances: How likely each mishap is. 0 switches a mechanic off. Everything else – damage, radii, durations, item lists – sits in the block below.
imm-desc-advanced: On/off switches, damage, radii, durations and item lists. Flatulence and bears opening doors have no percentage of their own, so they only appear here.
imm-onlysurvival-desc: Off = the bad luck also hits players in creative mode (handy for testing).
imm-plant-replant: Runaway plant – seconds until it replants itself
imm-stone-chance-desc: When starting a knapping surface (stone or flint).
imm-ants-chance-desc: When sitting down on soil or grass.
imm-ants-dps: Fire ants – poison damage per second (HP)
imm-hornets-chance-desc: For every new block of soil or grass the player steps onto.
imm-explode-chance-desc: On the first impact of a thrown stone. Does not destroy blocks.
imm-explode-damage: Exploding stone – damage at the center (HP)
imm-explode-thrown: Exploding stone – which thrown items count
imm-explode-thrown-desc: Stones thrown by hand fly as a generic thrown item, so the mod checks what is inside. Sling stones always count.
imm-stick-chance-desc: Each time the result is taken out while a stick is in the recipe. Only the stick is lost.
imm-flat-farts-desc: Per vegetable eaten or per vegetable portion of a meal. Fresh = just harvested, ancient = about to rot; smoothly in between.
imm-flat-radius-desc: Aggressive creatures within this radius walk to the spot of the fart.
imm-flat-notice-desc: Bonus on the distance from which creatures notice the player. 0.5 = 50 % farther.
imm-flat-notice-seconds: Flatulence – easier to notice for seconds
imm-flat-dizzy-radius: Flatulence – dizziness radius for other players (blocks)
imm-flat-dizzy-desc: 0 = off. Uses the game's drunk wobble (maximum 1.1).
imm-flat-codes-desc: Which items count as vegetables, * as wildcard. Also applies to ingredients in meals.
imm-flat-luretags-desc: Game tags of creatures that come. ferocious = predators (wolf, bear, hyena), rust-creature = drifter, bowtorn, shiver.
imm-flat-lurecodes-desc: Additional creatures by code, * as wildcard (e.g. locusts or creatures from mods).
imm-flat-lureexclude-desc: Exceptions even if tag or code match (e.g. panda and sun bear).
imm-splinter-enabled-desc: When a stick breaks while crafting, you get a splinter.
imm-splinter-minutes-desc: Real time, only counts down while online. Another splinter extends the time.
imm-splinter-damage-desc: The splinter never kills, it stops at 1 HP.
imm-splinter-building: Splinter – stings when building and using
imm-splinter-bandage: Splinter – bandage or poultice removes it
imm-splinter-tools-desc: Per tool action that costs durability (mining, felling, tilling, hammering …). Wooden handle = a stick is in the recipe.
imm-bear-enabled-desc: A bear walks up to any closed door near it, stares, paws at it and opens it – any kind, even locked ones. Fragile doors get torn out. A player it is hunting always comes first.
imm-bear-stare: Bears open doors – staring in front of the door (seconds)
imm-bear-radius: Bears open doors – how far a bear looks for doors (blocks)
imm-bear-radius-desc: Searched around the bear itself, every two seconds. Larger values cost more server time.
imm-bear-lured: Bears open doors – also when lured by a fart
imm-snake-chance: Snake – chance per felled broadleaf tree (%)
imm-snake-woods-desc: Conifers: no snake ever falls from these trees.
eyechip-message: A stone chip flew into your eye!
door-flyoff: The door flew off its hinges!
toolfly-message: Your {0} slipped out of your hand!
torchfire-message: The wind blew your torch flame onto your ragged clothes!
imm-eyechip-enabled: Stone chip in the eye – enabled
imm-eyechip-chance: Stone chip in the eye – chance per rock/ore block (%)
imm-eyechip-knapping: Stone chip in the eye – chance per knapped chip (%)
imm-eyechip-knapping-desc: Knapping knocks off a lot of chips, so keep this value low.
imm-eyechip-duration: Stone chip in the eye – duration (seconds)
imm-eyechip-codes: Stone chip in the eye – which blocks (codes)
imm-hinges-open: Door off its hinges – when opening
imm-hinges-close: Door off its hinges – when closing
imm-hinges-bear: Door off its hinges – when a bear opens it
imm-toolfly-enabled: Tool slips out of hand – enabled
imm-toolfly-chance: Tool slips out of hand – chance per use (%)
imm-toolfly-chance-desc: Every use that costs durability. Applies to all tools and weapons in hand.
imm-toolfly-damage: Tool slips out of hand – damage on hit (HP)
imm-toolfly-distance: Tool flies out of the hand – maximum distance (blocks)
imm-toolfly-distance-desc: How far the tool lands away from you at most. Every throw uses between 55 % and 100 % of it.
imm-torch-chance: Torch against the wind – chance per second (%)
imm-torch-wind: Torch against the wind – minimum wind speed
imm-torch-wind-desc: About 0.2 = light breeze, 0.5 = strong wind, 1 = storm.
imm-torch-angle: Torch against the wind – angle to the headwind direction (degrees)
imm-torch-clothing: Torch against the wind – average clothing condition below (%)
cliff-message: Your foot slipped off the edge!
imm-cliff-chance: Cliff – chance per second while sneaking at an edge (%)
imm-stumble-chance: Stumbling – chance per second while moving (%)
imm-stumble-chance-desc: Drunk and chased at the same time counts double.
imm-stumble-intox-desc: The game's intoxication value, 0 to 1.1. About 0.2 = vision starts to wobble.
imm-stumble-range: Stumbling – chaser counts up to distance (blocks)
runningplant-message: Your crop jumped out of the ground and ran away!
eatstone-message: Crunch! You ate the stone instead of knapping it.
fireants-message: Fire ants! You sat right on their nest.
hornets-message: You stepped on a hornet nest!
fart-small: You let out a small fart.
fart-medium: You let out a loud fart. Something might have smelled that.
fart-large: You let out a horrendous fart! Everything around can smell it.
fart-lure: Something out there catches the scent and is coming closer.
bear-door-torn: A bear tore the door out!
snake-message: A snake fell out of the tree onto your head!
fartcloud-message: You walked right into a fart cloud... everything starts to swirl.
imm-flat-cloudpsy: Flatulence – cloud causes a mushroom trip
imm-flat-cloudpsy-desc: Anyone except the one who farted who walks into the cloud gets the psychedelic mushroom effect once per cloud.
imm-flat-psyfresh: Flatulence – trip strength with fresh vegetables
imm-flat-psyold: Flatulence – trip strength with ancient vegetables
imm-flat-psy-desc: Game value: fly agaric 0.4, goldcap 1.0, liberty cap 1.4, blue meanie 2.0 (maximum 2).
choking-message: You choked on your food and started coughing!
imm-choking-chance-desc: Per item eaten or per serving of a meal.
imm-choking-notice-desc: Bonus on the distance from which creatures notice you. 1 = twice as far.
imm-choking-noticesec: Choking – easier to notice for seconds
mimic-message: The chest snaps open - it's a mimic!
imm-mimic-chance-desc: Fixed per position: the same chest is always or never a mimic.
imm-mimic-structures-desc: Worldgen structures, e.g. *ruin* for all ruins, *dungeon* for dungeons.
imm-stupid-desc: Replaces the sounds of nine mishaps with meme versions: bear opening a door, your farts, a snake dropping on you, slipping off a cliff, tripping over, a tool slipping out of your hand, eating a stone, a stone chip in the eye and a stick snapping.
imm-stumble-sprint-desc: On top of being drunk or chased, you now have to be sprinting to trip.
imm-bear-retreat: Bears open doors – retreat after a kill (seconds)
imm-bear-retreat-desc: A bear that opened a door and then killed the player runs off instead of waiting inside the house. 0 switches that safeguard off.
imm-bear-retreat-blocks: Bears open doors – how far the bear retreats (blocks)
imm-bear-retreat-after: Bears open doors – door counts for this long (seconds)
imm-bear-retreat-after-desc: Only a kill within this time after opening a door makes the bear retreat. A kill out in the wild does not.
imm-bear-tearout: Bears open doors – which gates always break
imm-bear-tearout-desc: These do not survive a bear: instead of swinging open they are torn out and drop as an item. Fragile doors always break anyway.
boomerang-message: Your own stone came flying back and hit you!
imm-boomerang-chance: Stone comes back – chance per throw (%)
imm-boomerang-chance-desc: A thrown stone turns around in mid-air, steers at you and hits you on the head. Sling stones count too.
imm-boomerang-after: Stone comes back – turns around after (seconds)
imm-boomerang-after-desc: Below 0.5 seconds the game still counts the stone as your own and it flies through you.
imm-explode-blocks-desc: The blast tears a hole into the ground, like a real explosion. Off means creatures only.
imm-explode-blockdrop: Exploding stone – how much of the rubble drops (0 to 1)
imm-explode-blockdrop-desc: 1 = everything can be picked up, 0 = the blocks are simply gone.
